standard.summary: lulynx_optimized 是本仓 teacher-regression 组合；standard 使用独立 teacher/fake 双 score provider，缺失时后端 fail-fast。
standard.effect: Anima standard 会在加载 teacher/fake/student 前复核 faithful Qwen3+T5 cache；旧 cache 可由本地 VAE/Qwen3/T5 组件自动重建，组件缺失或重建后仍不兼容时直接报错停下。lulynx_optimized 保持既有 cache-first 行为。
standard.whenToUse: 只有在 Anima faithful cache-first 数据与独立 teacher/fake 生命周期可用时选择 standard；需要兼容既有训练结果时选择 lulynx_optimized（默认）。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要把 standard 当成 lulynx_optimized 的调参近似——两者不是同一条损失路线。

standard_en.summary: lulynx_optimized is this repository's teacher-regression combination; standard uses separate teacher/fake score providers and fails fast when they are missing.
standard_en.effect: On Anima, standard re-checks the faithful Qwen3+T5 cache before loading teacher, fake and student; an old cache can be rebuilt automatically from the local VAE/Qwen3/T5 components, and it fails fast when a component is missing or the rebuild is still incompatible. lulynx_optimized keeps the existing cache-first behaviour.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose standard only when Anima faithful cache-first data and separate teacher/fake lifecycles are available; choose lulynx_optimized (default) when you need compatibility with existing training results.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not treat standard as a tuned approximation of lulynx_optimized -- they are not the same loss route.

advanced.principle: lulynx_optimized 使用 teacher prediction regression 及可选 anchor/critic/SoftRank；standard 不是该 MSE 组合的别名，使用独立 teacher/fake score 与 5:1 默认更新节奏。
advanced.tradeoffs: standard 当前为单进程路径且需要三套独立 DiT；旧 cache 迁移会重新编码数据。它不会退回 raw-Qwen 或 teacher MSE，两种模式的训练成本和质量不能互相外推。

advanced_en.principle: lulynx_optimized uses teacher prediction regression plus optional anchor/critic/SoftRank; standard is not an alias for that MSE combination -- it uses an independent teacher/fake score and a 5:1 default update cadence.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: standard is currently a single-process path requiring three independent DiTs; legacy cache migration re-encodes data. It does not fall back to raw-Qwen or teacher MSE, and the two modes' training cost and quality cannot be extrapolated to each other.
